SECTION_DISPLAY_DESC: The theme runs at {url}. The Volumio UI stays available on port 3000. The Touch Display plugin is required for the local screen.
KIOSK_DOC: Sets this theme as the start page of the Volumio kiosk. Disabling restores the default UI.
PORT_DOC: Port of the theme web server (default: 4005).
RESTART_KIOSK_DOC: Restarts the kiosk browser, e.g. after an update.
ACCENT_MODE_DOC: Derive it from the album art or use a fixed colour.
ACCENT_COLOR_DOC: Hex value, e.g. #3ddc97. Also used when no colour can be derived from the album art.
BACKGROUND_DOC: Blurred album art looks nicer, plain is easier on slow hardware.
MARQUEE_DOC: Long titles scroll slowly instead of being cut off.
KEYBOARD_DOC: Shows a large keyboard in search that fits the narrow display.
HIDE_CURSOR_DOC: Kiosk display only. The cursor stays visible in a regular browser.
IDLE_TIMEOUT_DOC: Shows a dimmed clock while nothing is playing and the display is not touched. 0 = off.
KIOSK_APPLIED: Kiosk now shows the Touch Bar Theme
KIOSK_RESTORED: Kiosk shows the default UI again
KIOSK_MISSING: No kiosk found. Please install and enable the Touch Display plugin.
SERVER_ERROR: Theme server could not be started
ANALYZER_DOC: Frequency bars behind the position slider, for every source (library, web radio, AirPlay, Spotify, Bluetooth …). Changes take effect the next time playback starts.
ANALYZER_DELAY_DOC: Delays the bars if they run ahead of the sound. 0 is usually right because the analyzer taps the audio right before the DAC.
TAB_LABELS_DOC: Shows the name below the queue, library and search icons.
ANALYZER_FAILED: The band analyzer could not be activated (see log). Playback is not affected.
PORT80_DOC: Redirects http://volumio.local (port 80) to the theme. Volumio's own UI stays available at http://volumio.local:3000.
PORT80_APPLIED: volumio.local now shows the Touch Bar Theme
PORT80_RESTORED: volumio.local shows the Volumio UI again
